verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own cross-meeting search: AI Chat searches across your meetings, past calls can be queried in natural language, uploaded media becomes searchable text, and its MCP server can search transcripts across all time periods. One hands-on user also reports going back to details they hadn't noted. Nothing in the pack shows explicit search over summaries and notes, or jumping to a timestamped moment in a recording. Missing for 10: jump-to-exact-moment/timestamp playback, explicit search over summaries and notes, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-meeting search.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
